page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at top, page number at top right. Catchword at lower right, gathering signature at lower centre. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: nempe regem Assur. Et erit in die illa, sibi-labit Dominus muscæ, quæ est in extremi-tate rivorum Ægypti, & api quæ est in ter-ra Assur. Venientq; omnes illę[?], & quiescent in vallibus desolationum, & in cavernis petrarum, ac in omnibus spinetis & dumetis.

In die illa radet Dominus in novacula conducta, in his qui ultra fluviū sunt cum rege Assur, caput & pilos pedum: sed & barbam exterminabit. Et erit in die illa, nutriet homo vaccam armenti & duas oves. Et erit propter copiam lactis, quam facient, comedet butyrum: quia butyrũ & mel comedet, quicunque relictus fuerit in medio terræ.

Erit quoq; in die illa, ut sit omnis locus, in quo sunt mille vites, mille (adæquatæ) ar-genteis, in spinas & vepres. Cum sagittis & arcu veniet illuc: quoniam spinæ & vepres erunt per universam terram. Sed & omnes montes, qui farculo fodiuntur, non veniet illuc timor spinarum & veprium: sed erit, ut (illuc) mittantur boves, & conculcent pecora.
main_text.head: ANNOTATIONES.
main_text.p: FActum est autem in diebus Achaz,&c.) Hæc est tertia pars huius Operis, continens visiones & concniones habitas sub Rege Achaz, sicut hic

page.notes: Page number "71" printed at top right, the "1" set raised; read as 71 with some doubt. Signature at foot read as "c 4", uncertain. Catchword "diserte" is printed at the lower right. Faint show-through of the other side is ignored. Normalised u/v per the rules (e.g. vallibus, vaccam, vepres, universam, rivorum, fluviū). The word "illę" is uncertain: the ę may be a worn ligature. The italic line after "FActum" is taken as italic throughout; the drop-cap F is joined to its word. Hyphens kept only where printed at line ends ("sibi-", "extremi-", "ter-", "ar-"); "conducta", "petrarum" and "comedet" are written whole because no hyphen is printed at those breaks.
